--- create_search_index_partition_by_interleave.sql
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex
ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens)
PARTITION BY SingerId, AlbumId
, INTERLEAVE IN Singers
--- AST
&ast.CreateSearchIndex{
  Name: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 20,
        NameEnd: 31,
        Name:    "AlbumsIndex",
      },
    },
  },
  TableName: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 35,
        NameEnd: 41,
        Name:    "Albums",
      },
    },
  },
  TokenListPart: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 42,
      NameEnd: 59,
      Name:    "AlbumTitle_Tokens",
    },
  },
  Rparen:           59,
  PartitionColumns: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 74,
      NameEnd: 82,
      Name:    "SingerId",
    },
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 84,
      NameEnd: 91,
      Name:    "AlbumId",
    },
  },
  Interleave: &ast.InterleaveIn{
    Comma:     92,
    TableName: &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 108,
      NameEnd: 115,
      Name:    "Singers",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens) PARTITION BY SingerId, AlbumId, INTERLEAVE IN Singers
